markets.name: goods
markets.summary: People sell everyday things, new or used.
markets.description: Not motor vehicles or homes, and ship only what either side could lose without real harm.

markets.name: home-gardening
markets.summary: Gardeners mow, prune, plant and care for people's gardens.
markets.description: Caring for a garden, not landscaping, building or felling trees. Repairs are home-repair, and cleaning is home-cleaning.

markets.name: home-repair
markets.summary: Repairers do plumbing, electrical and handyman jobs in people's homes.
markets.description: Repairs and small jobs in a home, not renovations or building work. Garden work is home-gardening, and cleaning is home-cleaning.

markets.name: language-exchange
markets.summary: Two people practise each other's language, taking turns.
markets.description: For adults only, practising for free; paid lessons are tutoring.

markets.name: software
markets.summary: Developers build and fix software, AI, data and automation, remotely.
markets.description: Security work included; not design alone, video or hardware.

markets.name: sports-coaching
markets.summary: Coaches teach a sport or fitness, one on one or in groups.
markets.description: Sport and fitness; desk subjects and chess are tutoring. The student is whoever arranges the coaching, often a parent, who stays present for a child's session in person.

markets.name: stays-free
markets.summary: Hosts give guests a couch or a room for free.
markets.description: For adults only, staying for free; a bed for help is stays-work.

markets.name: stays-work
markets.summary: Hosts give guests a bed, and often meals, for their help.
markets.description: For adults only, and never childcare. A free stay with no help is stays-free, and help for a cause with no bed is volunteering.

markets.name: tours
markets.summary: Local guides show people around their town or its nature.
markets.description: For adults, who may bring their own children. Learning a sport, such as surfing, is sports-coaching.

markets.name: tutoring
markets.summary: Tutors teach school subjects, languages, chess and other desk subjects.
markets.description: School subjects, languages and chess; sport and fitness are sports-coaching, and practising a language for free is language-exchange. The student is whoever arranges the lessons, often a parent, who stays present for a child's lesson in person.

markets.name: volunteering
markets.summary: Volunteers give their time to cleanups, food banks, events and good causes.
markets.description: A bed for help is stays-work. Never caring for children or for people who need care, and in person for adults only.
